With weighted routing, users can associate multiple resources with a single domain name (such as example.com) or a subdomain name (such as acme.example.com) and choose how much traffic is routed to each resource. This feature can be useful for a variety of purposes, including load balancing and testing new versions of software./ppFor more information about Route 53 routing policies, see a   href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html"Choosing a routing policy/a. /pp

question_content: pA retail company that has a global customer base is updating an online catalog application for a new product line. The static assets are stored on an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system that is mounted on Amazon EC2 instances that are used as web servers. The company has deployed an Amazon CloudFront distribution and has set the web servers as the distribution's origin./p  pThe company wants to limit the number of requests that are routed back to the origin for the static assets. The company also wants to increase the proportion of requests that are served directly from CloudFront's cache./p  pWhich action can a SysOps administrator take to improve the cache hit ratio?

answer_choices.choice_content: pModify the existing CloudFront distribution, and enable the Origin Shield feature.
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. The cache hit ratio can be improved by increasing the proportion of viewer requests that are served directly from the CloudFront cache instead of going to the origin servers for content. A number of methods can be used to improve the cache hit ratio, including increasing the TTL and enabling Origin Shield on a CloudFront distribution./ppEnabling Origin Shield to improve the cache hit ratio reduces the load on the origin and can help improve performance and cost-effectiveness. To enable Origin Shield, change the origin settings in a CloudFront distribution. Origin Shield is a property of the origin. For each origin in a CloudFront distribution, separately enable Origin Shield in the AWS Region that provides the best performance for that origin./ppFor more information about how to enable Origin Shield, see a   href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/origin-shield.html#enable-origin-shield"Enabling Origin Shield/a.  /ppFor more information about how to improve the cache hit ratio, see a   href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/cache-hit-ratio.html"Increasing the proportion of requests that are served directly from the CloudFront caches (cache hit ratio)/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pModify the existing CloudFront distribution by setting the Minimum TTL value to 0.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. The Minimum TTL value specifies the minimum amount of time, in seconds, for objects to stay in CloudFront caches before CloudFront forwards another request to the origin to determine whether the object has been updated. To specify a Minimum TTL value, choose the Customize option for the Object Caching setting. The default value for Minimum TTL is 0 seconds. With this configuration, CloudFront never caches the associated objects. Instead, CloudFront forwards all requests for those objects to the origin.

answer_choices.choice_content: pModify the existing CloudFront distribution's origin to point directly to the EFS file system.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. The CloudFront distribution in this scenario is already pointing to a custom origin. A custom origin is an HTTP server (for example, a web server). The HTTP server can be an Amazon EC2 instance or an HTTP server that can be managed privately. An Amazon S3 origin that is configured as a website endpoint is also considered a custom origin. EFS file systems do not have the capability to directly serve HTTP content, so they cannot act as a custom origin for CloudFront.

answer_choices.choice_content: pModify the existing CloudFront distribution, and enable Real Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP) distributions.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. RTMP distributions stream media files by using Adobe Media Server and the Adobe RTMP. This solution would not improve the cache hit ratio. More importantly, RTMP uses Adobe Flash. Adobe designated Flash as end-of-life at the end of 2020. As a result, CloudFront no longer supports Adobe Flash Media Server and deprecated RTMP distributions on December 31, 2020. This makes RTMP an incorrect solution for any existing application.

question_content: pA company wants to launch a group of Amazon EC2 instances that need to communicate with each other with the lowest possible latency./ppWhich combination of actions should a SysOps administrator take when launching these instances? (Select TWO.)

answer_choices.choice_content: pLaunch instances in different VPCs with a VPN tunnel.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. A VPN connection between VPCs adds additional network layers between the instances. A solution with lower latency would involve fewer layers./ppFor more about VPN connections, see a  href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html" What is AWS Site-to-Site VPN?/a

answer_choices.choice_content: pLaunch instances in different VPCs with VPC peering enabled.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Peering provides network connectivity between VPCs. However, the scenario for this question does not require the use of multiple VPCs. This solution does not provide the lowest possible latency./ppFor more about VPC peering, see a  href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/what-is-vpc-peering.html" What is VPC peering?/a

answer_choices.choice_content: pLaunch instances in a cluster placement group.
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. You can use placement groups to influence the placement of a group of interdependent instances to meet the needs of your workload. Cluster placement groups pack instances close together inside an Availability Zone. With this strategy, workloads can achieve low-latency network performance./ppFor more about placement groups, see a  href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-groups.html" Placement groups/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pLaunch instances in a spread placement group.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. You can use placement groups to influence the placement of a group of interdependent instances to meet the needs of your workload. However, spread placement groups distribute instances on different underlying hardware. This solution does not provide the lowest possible latency./ppFor more about placement groups, see a  href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-groups.html" Placement groups/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pLaunch instances with enhanced networking enabled.
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. Amazon EC2 provides a wide selection of instance types that are optimized to fit different use cases. Instance types comprise different combinations of CPU, memory, storage, and networking capacity. Instance types that include enhanced networking provide workloads access to consistent bandwidth and lower aggregate latency./ppFor more about enhanced networking, see a  href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/real-time-communication-on-aws/use-enhanced-networking-ec2-instance-types.html" Use Enhanced Networking EC2 Instance Types/a.

question_content: pA company that hosts a multi-tier ecommerce web application on AWS has been alerted to suspicious application traffic. The architecture consists of Amazon EC2 instances deployed across multiple Availability Zones behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). After examining the instance logs, a SysOps administrator determines that the suspicious traffic is an attempted SQL injection attack./ppWhat should the SysOps administrator do to prevent similar attacks?

answer_choices.choice_content: pCreate an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the ALB as the origin. Enable AWS Shield Advanced to protect from SQL injection attacks at edge locations.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. There are two tiers of AWS Shield: Standard and Advanced. In addition to the network and transport layer protections that come with Shield Standard, Shield Advanced provides additional detection and mitigation against large and sophisticated DDoS attacks. Shield Advanced also offers near-real-time visibility into attacks and integration with AWS WAF./ppFor more information about Shield Standard and Shield Advanced, see a   href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-overview.html"How AWS Shield works/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pCreate an AWS WAF web ACL, and configure a SQL injection rule to add to the web ACL. Associate the AWS WAF web ACL with the ALB.
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. Attackers sometimes insert malicious SQL code into web requests to extract data from your database. To block web requests that appear to contain malicious SQL code, you can create one or more SQL injection match conditions in an AWS WAF web ACL. SQL injection match conditions detect the presence of SQL code that is likely to be malicious./ppFor more information about AWS WAF protection, see a  href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-chapter.html" AWS WAF/a./ppFor more information about SQL injection, see a  href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-sqli-match.html" SQL injection attack rule statement/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pEnable Amazon GuardDuty. Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke an AWS Lambda function every time GuardDuty detects SQL injection.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. GuardDuty is a continuous security monitoring service that analyzes and processes the following data sources: VPC Flow Logs, AWS CloudTrail management event logs, CloudTrail S3 data event logs, and DNS logs. GuardDuty uses threat intelligence feeds, such as lists of malicious IP addresses and domains, and machine learning to identify unexpected and potentially unauthorized and malicious activity within your AWS environment. However, GuardDuty does not prevent SQL injection attacks./ppFor more information about GuardDuty, see a   href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html"What is Amazon GuardDuty?/a

answer_choices.choice_content: pInstall Amazon Inspector on the EC2 instances, and configure a rules package. Use the findings reports to identify and block SQL injection attacks.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Amazon Inspector tests the network accessibility of your EC2 instances and the security state of your applications that run on those instances. Amazon Inspector assesses applications for exposure, vulnerabilities, and deviations from best practices. After performing an assessment, Amazon Inspector produces a detailed list of security findings that is organized by level of severity. However, Amazon Inspector does not prevent SQL injection attacks./ppFor more information about Amazon Inspector, see a   href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/userguide/inspector_introduction.html"What is Amazon Inspector?/a

question_content: pA company wants to track Amazon EC2 usage charges that are based on the value of a tag that is named Business-Unit. The finance team member sees EC2 costs in the different accounts but cannot find the Business-Unit tag to filter by or group by./p  pWhat is the MOST likely reason that the Business-Unit tag is absent?

answer_choices.choice_content: pThe Business-Unit tag is not activated as a cost allocation tag in the AWS Billing and Cost Management console.
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. To filter by or group by cost that is based on tags in Cost Explorer, the tag key must be activated as a cost allocation tag. The ability to analyze cost by tag in Cost Explorer is a two-step process. You must tag the resources and activate the tags as cost allocation tags./ppFor more information about user-defined cost allocation tags, see a   href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/custom-tags.html"User-Defined Cost Allocation Tags/a. /ppFor more information about the monthly cost allocation report, see a   href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/configurecostallocreport.html"Monthly cost allocation report/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pThe Business-Unit tag is not valid because tag key names do not support dashes (-).
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. The tag key names support dashes. If the tag key names did not support dashes, the developers would not have been able to add the tag initially./ppFor more information about tag restrictions, see a   href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/Using_Tags.html#tag-restrictions"Tag restrictions/a. /pp

answer_choices.choice_content: pThe instances have been rebooted, and the developers neglected to re-add the Business-Unit tag after the reboot.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Instances do not lose their tags on reboot.

answer_choices.choice_content: pThe IAM user does not have permission to view the tags in Cost Explorer.

question_content: pA company is launching a campaign in which a workload must run on Amazon EC2 instances for the next 2 months. answer_choices.choice_content: pRegional Reserved Instances

question_content: pA company uses a shared Amazon S3 bucket to store data for several customers. answer_choices.choice_content: pThe team has opened Cost Explorer in the wrong AWS Region.

answer_choices.choice_content: pTags that are applied to S3 objects must have a tag key name that is unique from tags that are used by other resource types.

question_content: pA SysOps administrator needs an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume type for a big data application. question_content: pA company is running an application on Amazon EC2 instances that are located in a private subnet. The application requires access to data that is stored in an Amazon S3 bucket./p  pWhich solution meets this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

question_content: pA company runs a mobile app that hosts photos. Users from all over the world use their mobile devices to upload photos to the app for storage. answer_choices.choice_content: pUse AWS Transfer for SFTP for Amazon S3 on the S3 bucket.

question_content: pA robotics company is building an application that uses an Apache Cassandra cluster. The cluster runs on Amazon EC2 instances that will be deployed into a placement group. A SysOps administrator must design for maximum resiliency of the compute layer./p  pWhich deployment strategy meets this requirement?

answer_choices.choice_content: pDeploy a partition placement group across a single Availability Zone.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Partition placement groups help reduce the likelihood of correlated hardware failures for an application. A partition placement group can place partitions in multiple Availability Zones in the same AWS Region. By limiting a deployment to a single Availability Zone, the SysOps administrator has not implemented the most resilient solution./ppFor more information about partition placement groups, see a   href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-groups.html#placement-groups-partition"Partition placement groups/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pDeploy a partition placement group across multiple Availability Zones.
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. There are three types of placement groups: cluster, partition, and spread. Cluster placement groups provide the closest physical placement of instances. Instances in the same cluster placement group have a higher throughput limit for each flow for TCP/IP traffic and are placed in the same high-bisection bandwidth segment of the network. Cluster placement groups are Single-AZ deployments only./ppWhen resiliency is most important, partition and spread placement groups provide options of Single-AZ or Multi-AZ deployments while ensuring that individual nodes run on separate racks. Partition placement groups divide the cluster into three partitions that are physically separated in the Availability Zone. Spread placement groups place each instance on its own rack inside the Availability Zone. Service quotas can be a factor in the selection of a placement group./ppFor more information about placement groups, see a   href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-groups.html"Placement groups/a. /ppFor more information about how to implement Apache Cassandra on EC2 instances, see a   href="https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/big-data/best-practices-for-running-apache-cassandra-on-amazon-ec2/"Best Practices for Running Apache Cassandra on Amazon EC2/a. /pp

answer_choices.choice_content: pDeploy a cluster placement group across a single Availability Zone.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. A cluster placement group is a logical grouping of instances within a single Availability Zone. This solution helps workloads achieve the low-latency network performance necessary for tightly coupled node-to-node communication. This solution does not provide the most resiliency because a localized hardware failure could impact multiple EC2 instances./ppFor more information about cluster placement groups, see a   href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-groups.html#placement-groups-cluster"Cluster placement groups/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pDeploy a cluster placement group across multiple Availability Zones.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. A cluster placement group is a logical grouping of instances within a single Availability Zone. A cluster placement group cannot extend across multiple Availability Zones./ppFor more information about cluster placement groups, see a   href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-groups.html#placement-groups-cluster"Cluster placement groups/a.

question_content: pA web-commerce application stores its data in an Amazon Aurora DB cluster with an Aurora Replica. The application displays shopping cart information by reading data from the reader endpoint. When monitoring the Aurora database, a SysOps administrator sees that the AuroraReplicaLagMaximum metric for a single replica is high./pp/ppWhat behavior is the application MOST likely exhibiting to users?/p

answer_choices.choice_content: pUsers cannot add any items to the shopping cart./p
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. A lag on the replica would not affect the ability to add items to the cart because that operation is a write operation./p

answer_choices.choice_content: pUsers cannot remove any items from the shopping cart./p
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. A lag on the replica would not affect the ability to remove items from the cart because that operation is a write operation./p

answer_choices.choice_content: pUsers cannot use the application because it is falling back to an error page./p
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. The application is still able to read the shopping cart. The application is just getting old data. This lag would not cause an application error./p

answer_choices.choice_content: pUsers intermittently notice that the cart is not updated correctly./p
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. A reader endpoint is an endpoint for an Aurora DB cluster that connects to one of the available Aurora Replicas for that DB cluster. Each Aurora DB cluster has a reader endpoint. If there is more than one Aurora Replica, the reader endpoint directs each connection request to one of the Aurora Replicas./pp/ppReplica lag is the amount of time in milliseconds that the Aurora Replica is delayed in having the same query response as the primary instance. question_content: pA company hosts an internal application on Amazon EC2 instances. All application data and requests route through an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between the on-premises network and AWS. The company must monitor the application for changes that allow network access outside of the corporate network. Any change that exposes the application externally must be restricted automatically. /pp/ppWhich solution meets these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient manner?/pp/p

answer_choices.choice_content: pCloudWatch Logs. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that matches traffic from noncorporate CIDR ranges, and publish a message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic with the Lambda function as a target./p
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. VPC Flow Logs records traffic to the application. VPC Flow Logs cannot stop external traffic. You need to ensure that the application is not externally accessible./pp/ppFor more information about VPC Flow Logs, see span style="text-decoration: underline;"a href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/flow-logs.html" Logging IP Traffic Using VPC Flow Logs/a/span./pp/ppFor more information about CloudWatch Logs, see span style="text-decoration: underline;"a href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/WhatIsCloudWatchLogs.html" What Is Amazon CloudWatch Logs?/a/spana href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/WhatIsCloudWatchLogs.html"  /a/p

answer_choices.choice_content: pCreate a scheduled Amazon EventBridge rule that targets an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook to check for public IP addresses on the EC2 instances. If public IP addresses are found on the EC2 instances, initiate another Systems Manager Automation runbook to terminate the instances./p
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. The scheduled EventBridge rule will detect changes on a periodically configured interval. Therefore, this solution is not operationally efficient./pp/ppFor more information about EventBridge rules, see span style="text-decoration: underline;"a href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-rules.html" Amazon EventBridge Rules/a/span./p

answer_choices.choice_content: pConfigure AWS Config and a custom rule to monitor whether a security group allows inbound requests from noncorporate CIDR ranges. Create an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook to remove any noncorporate CIDR ranges from the application security groups./p
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. You can use AWS Config to evaluate your resource configurations. AWS Config gives you the ability to determine if the configurations align with internal policies, industry standards, and regulations. You can create a custom AWS Config rule to monitor changes in security groups. You can use a Systems Manager Automation runbook to outline the actions that Systems Manager runs on your managed EC2 instances. In this scenario, you would remove noncorporate CIDR ranges from the application security groups./pp/ppFor more information about how to remediate noncompliant resources, see span style="text-decoration: underline;"a href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/remediation.html" Remediating Noncompliant Resources with AWS Config Rules/a/span./pp/ppFor more information about custom rules, see span style="text-decoration: underline;"a href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/evaluate-config_develop-rules.html" AWS Config Custom Rules/a/span./p

answer_choices.choice_content: pConfigure AWS Config and the managed rule for monitoring public IP associations with the EC2 instances by tag. Tag the EC2 instances with an identifier. Create an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook to remove the public IP association from the EC2 instances./p
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. You can use the ec2-instance-no-public-ip managed config rule to check whether EC2 instances have a public IP association. However, the rule does not check for network access outside of the corporate network./pp/ppFor more information about the ec2-instance-no-public-ip managed rule, see span style="text-decoration: underline;"a href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/ec2-instance-no-public-ip.html" ec2-instance-no-public-ip/a/span./p

question_content: pA company has 10 Amazon EC2 instances in its production account. A SysOps administrator must ensure that email notifications are sent to administrators each time there is an EC2 instance state change./pp/ppWhich solution will meet this requirement?/p

answer_choices.choice_content: pspan style="font-family: inherit; font-size: inherit; font-style: inherit; font-variant-ligatures: inherit; font-variant-caps: inherit; font-weight: inherit;"Configure an Amazon Route 53 simple routing policy that publishes a message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic when an EC2 instance state changes. This SNS topic then sends notifications to its email subscribers./span/p
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. You can use a Route 53 simple routing policy to route traffic to a single resource such as a web server for your website. A Route 53 simple routing policy cannot determine when an EC2 instance state changes. The scenario does not state that the EC2 instances connect to Route 53./pp/ppFor more information about the Route 53 simple routing policy, see span style="text-decoration: underline;"a href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html" Choosing a Routing Policy/a/span./pp/p

answer_choices.choice_content: pConfigure an Amazon Route 53 simple routing policy that publishes a message to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue when an EC2 instance state changes. This SQS queue then sends notifications to its email subscribers./p
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. You can use a Route 53 simple routing policy to route traffic to a single resource such as a web server for your website. A Route 53 simple routing policy cannot determine when an EC2 instance state changes. The scenario does not state that the EC2 instances connect to Route 53. Amazon SQS is a queuing service. You cannot use Amazon SQS to send notifications./pp/ppFor more information about the Route 53 simple routing policy, see span style="text-decoration: underline;"a href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html" Choosing a Routing Policy/a/span./pp/ppFor more information about Amazon SQS, see span style="text-decoration: underline;"a href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/welcome.html" What Is Amazon Simple Queue Service?/a/spana href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/welcome.html"  /a/p

answer_choices.choice_content: pCreate an Amazon EventBridge rule that publishes a message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic when an EC2 instance state changes. This SNS topic then sends notifications to its email subscribers./p
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. You can use EventBridge events to link application components together. EventBridge gives you the ability to build scalable event-driven solutions. When the state of an EC2 Fleet changes, the fleet sends a notification. The notification is made available as an event. Then the event is sent to EventBridge. You can use EventBridge to publish the state change message to an SNS topic./pp/ppFor more information about Amazon EC2 instance state change event, see span style="text-decoration: underline;"a href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-fleet-event-types.html#ec2-fleet-state-change" EC2 Fleet State Change/a/span./pp/ppFor more information about Amazon SNS, see span style="text-decoration: underline;"a href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html"What Is Amazon SNS?/a/span/p

answer_choices.choice_content: pCreate an Amazon EventBridge rule that publishes a message to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue when an EC2 instance state changes. This SQS queue then sends notifications to its email subscribers./p
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Amazon SQS is a queuing service. You cannot use Amazon SQS to send notifications. Amazon SNS sends notifications./pp/ppFor more information about Amazon SQS, see span style="text-decoration: underline;"a href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/welcome.html" What Is Amazon Simple Queue Service?/a/span/p

question_content: pA company needs to meet a new compliance standard that prohibits unrestricted access to SSH on its Amazon EC2 instances. A SysOps administrator must configure a monitoring solution that includes auto-remediation if unrestricted SSH ports are identified./pp/ppWhich solution will meet these requirements?/p

answer_choices.choice_content: pConfigure an AWS Config rule that checks whether security groups that are in use allow unrestricted SSH traffic. Configure auto-remediation with an Amazon EventBridge event./p
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Although AWS Config does have the ability to check security groups as described, it uses Systems Manager Automation runbooks to remediate noncompliant resources./p

answer_choices.choice_content: pConfigure an AWS Config rule that checks whether security groups that are in use allow unrestricted SSH traffic. Configure auto-remediation with an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook./p
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. AWS Config can use AWS managed rules or custom rules. The restrict-ssh AWS Config managed rule checks whether the incoming SSH traffic for the security groups is accessible. The rule is compliant when IP addresses of the incoming SSH traffic in the security groups are restricted. AWS Config also has the ability to assign remediation measures for noncompliant resources. The remediation is managed with Systems Manager Automation runbooks. Users can configure the remediation to occur manually or automatically./pp/ppFor more information about the restrict-ssh managed rule, see a href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/restricted-ssh.html" span style="text-decoration: underline;"restricted-ssh/span/a./pp/ppFor more information about how to create custom rules for AWS Config, see a href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/evaluate-config_develop-rules.html" span style="text-decoration: underline;"AWS Config Custom Rules/span/a./pp/ppFor more information about about Systems Manager, see a href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/what-is-systems-manager.html" span style="text-decoration: underline;"What is AWS Systems Manager?/span/a /p

answer_choices.choice_content: pConfigure Amazon CloudWatch monitoring to check whether security groups that are in use allow unrestricted SSH traffic. Configure auto-remediation with an Amazon EventBridge event./p
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. CloudWatch monitoring does not have the ability to monitor security groups as described./p

question_content: pA SysOps administrator needs to configure a solution that will deliver digital content to a set of authorized users through Amazon CloudFront. Unauthorized users must be restricted from access./pp/ppWhich solution will meet these requirements?/p

answer_choices.choice_content: pStore the digital content in an Amazon S3 bucket that does not have public access blocked. Use signed URLs to access the S3 bucket through CloudFront./p
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. To meet the delivery requirement, you need an OAC to deliver the content through CloudFront./p

answer_choices.choice_content: pStore the digital content in an Amazon S3 bucket that has public access blocked. Use an origin access control (OAC) to deliver the content through CloudFront. Restrict S3 bucket access with signed URLs in CloudFront./p
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. CloudFront provides OACs to send authenticated requests to Amazon S3. To meet the requirements, you should store the digital content in an S3 bucket that has public access blocked. Then you should use the OAC to deliver the content through CloudFront. You can use CloudFront signed URLs to grant temporary access to the digital content to a set of authorized users./pp/ppFor more information about CloudFront, see span style="text-decoration: underline;"a href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html" What Is Amazon CloudFront?/a/spana href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html"  /a/pp/ppFor more information about OACs, see span style="text-decoration: underline;"a href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html" Restricting Access to an Amazon S3 Origin/a/span./pp/ppFor more information about signed URLs, see span style="text-decoration: underline;"a href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-signed-urls.html"Using Signed URLs/a/span./p

answer_choices.choice_content: pStore the digital content in an Amazon S3 bucket that has public access blocked. Use an origin access control (OAC) to deliver the content through CloudFront. Enable field-level encryption./p
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. You can use field-level encryption to encrypt specific fields within an HTTP request or response by using individual data keys. To meet the restriction requirements, you need signed URLs to restrict access to the digital content./pp/ppFor more information about field-level encryption, see span style="text-decoration: underline;"a href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/field-level-encryption.html" Using Field-Level Encryption to Help Protect Sensitive Data/a/span./p

answer_choices.choice_content: pStore the digital content in an Amazon S3 bucket that does not have public access blocked. Use signed cookies for restricted delivery of the content through CloudFront./p
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. You can use signed cookies to restrict access of the digital content. However, the S3 bucket must have public access blocked to meet the requirements. You also need OACs for content delivery./pp/ppFor more information about signed cookies, see span style="text-decoration: underline;"a href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-signed-cookies.html" Using signed cookies/a/span./p
